name: WORLD_CORE_V10_2_IMPLEMENTATION
entry_preconditions: ADR-09 remains APPROVED in docs/architecture/decisions/ADR-09.md for only the below-threshold registered GRAIN / Buyer Treasury GCU fixture.
The project owner explicitly authorized continuation on 2026-09-14.
V10.1 remains incomplete and unverified; this owner construction authorization is not a dependency-completion or Gate B declaration.
preserved_controls: Each proposal binds the canonical Command fingerprint, both country scopes, policy version, complete Office set, signed asset source, expiry, threshold policy version, and the fixed 6 GCU maximum settlement.
Every required signer is re-resolved at reservation time. A stale, revoked, missing, duplicate, or mismatched signature denies before ledger effect.

The Worker-owned durable approval store locks and binds only the exact immutable Command ledger intent, two country-scoped proposal records, immutable Office signatures, and their current authorization revisions. At the atomic cutoff it locks every current authorization row FOR UPDATE, so a revision or active-state change serializes with the effect. Its guard fails closed when omitted, stale, expired, or incomplete.
Reservation accepts only authoritative inventory lineage and emits only an exact AVAILABLE-to-RESERVED posting. No browser, fixture, cache, projection, or calibration input is authority.
No main merge, production/shared-Supabase connection or mutation, migration publication, deployment, original EconMind website change, V10.3 delivery/payment, or V11 work is authorized.
stop_conditions: A recorded P0 or MAJOR finding.
An unresolved applicable ADR or failed mandatory check.
Any need to exceed the exact V10.2 scope.
